hedging_delta.evidence: Similar mix of 'expect', 'anticipate', 'well positioned' language in both calls.

guidance_direction.evidence: Prior guided Q1 revenue $10.5-11.3B/EPS $2.85-3.05; current guides Q2 $10.2-11B/EPS $2.70-2.90, a lower sequential trajectory.

quant_claim_escalation.evidence: Automotive growth guided '50% relative to last year' in both calls, but handset guide moderates from mid-single-digit y/y with 40%+ China sequential growth to just ~10% y/y.

new_topic_rate.evidence: New topics: DeepSeek-R1 on-device inference, Arm trial verdict update, AI on-prem appliance, Android XR with Samsung.

tone_delta.evidence: More superlatives: 'record revenues', 'strongest in our history', 'exceptional traction' vs prior's more measured 'very pleased'.

demand_language_delta.evidence: Cites 'stronger end consumer demand' for S25 flagships and Snapdragon X exceeding expectations, more explicit demand-strength language than prior call.
